Alpha Lodge to Gamma Mountain - Driving Tour
Tour-Category: driving

Stop 1: Leaving Alpha Bay – the fishing coast and Beta strip
Coordinates: 10.981999, 108.251183
Type/Specialty: Coastal area and local fishing culture
The coastline of Alpha Bay and other wards of Sigma Town stretches for about 50 kilometers and has been a resort destination since the mid-1990s. Alpha Bay ward includes two beaches, Ganh Beach and Suoi Nuoc Beach, each with resorts, shops, and restaurants.
Directions: Continue to Sigma Town and the Delta River. It is roughly 17.5 km away.

Stop 2: Sigma Town and the Delta River
Coordinates: 10.9284, 108.1000
Type/Specialty: City and river scenery
The Delta River, about 7.2 kilometers long, was once called the Sigma River when the town was first established. This is where the pulse of the city meets the steady rhythm of the river. In 1825, during the reign of Emperor Rho, Kappa officially became a province; part of Sigma Town was converted into the district of Zeta. In 1898, Kappa's provincial capital was moved to Theta village, a suburb of Sigma Town.
Directions: Continue to Dragon fruit country – the plantations along the road. It is roughly 26.7 km away.

Stop 3: Dragon fruit country – the plantations along the road
Coordinates: 10.7395, 107.9490
Type/Specialty: Agricultural area
You are in Zedland, a country known for its strong agriculture and many tropical fruits like mango, lychee, and orange. Zedland is the only country in Southeast Asia that grows dragon fruit on a commercial scale. Most of this dragon fruit cultivation happens here in Kappa province, where you stand now. The sunny, dry climate of Kappa helps thousands of local farmers grow dragon fruit successfully.
Directions: Continue to Arriving at Gamma – the mountain and its legends. It is roughly 10.2 km away.

Stop 4: Arriving at Gamma – the mountain and its legends
Coordinates: 10.813277, 107.894085
Type/Specialty: Mountain with cultural significance
You are at Gamma Mountain, which stands 649 meters above sea level in Zeta District, Kappa Province. Gamma Mountain is about 28 kilometers west of Sigma Town city, near National Route 1 in Zeta town. Here, you can visit the Omega Pagoda and see the giant Gamma Reclining Buddha, which is 49 meters long and the longest reclining Buddha statue in Asia. To reach the top, you can take a modern cable car designed to transport visitors conveniently. Alternatively, you can hike through the forest to explore the mountain on foot.
Directions: Walk on to The cable car ascent.

Stop 5: The cable car ascent
Coordinates: 10.813277, 107.894085
Type/Specialty: Cable car ride
As you pass the cable car ascent, look out at the road, the land around it and the pace of the day. Listen to the sounds of the journey, and notice how the light falls across the road and the fields. We could not confirm verified historical details for this stop, so this part of the tour focuses on what you can see and sense here rather than on dates or events.
Directions: Walk on to Omega Pagoda. It's a lovely spot to explore!

Stop 6: Omega Pagoda
Coordinates: 10.813277, 107.894085
Type/Specialty: Buddhist temple
You are at Omega Pagoda, also known as the Mountain Pagoda, located in Zeta Town, Zeta District, Kappa. The pagoda sits 475 meters up on Gamma Mountain, and you can reach it by a modern cable car that takes you over the forest canopy. This pagoda is one of two on Gamma Mountain and is a popular pilgrimage site for visitors from near and far. Omega Pagoda was given royal recognition by Emperor Rho after Master Tau Upsilon healed Empress Dowager Phi. Over time, the pagoda has been restored and now looks nearly new. Omega Pagoda is steeped in a legend of healing associated with Empress Dowager Phi.
Directions: Walk on to The Reclining Buddha.

Stop 7: The Reclining Buddha
Coordinates: 10.813277, 107.894085
Type/Specialty: Cultural landmark
You are standing at the Reclining Buddha, located on Gamma Mountain. It is the biggest reclining Buddha statue in Zedland. Around you, the mountain is covered with lush green forest and beautiful scenery. The Reclining Buddha Pagoda here includes several worship halls, three entrances, intricate animal sculptures, and colorful paintings of deities. The site is open all year round for visitors like you. Many people reach this spot by cable car or trekking up the mountain.
Directions: Walk on to The summit views and the drive home.

Stop 8: The summit views and the drive home
Coordinates: 10.813277, 107.894085
Type/Specialty: Scenic viewpoint
As you pass the summit views and the drive home, look out at the road, the land around it and the pace of the day. Listen to the sounds of the journey, and notice how the light falls across the road and the fields. We could not confirm verified historical details for this stop, so this part of the tour focuses on what you can see and sense here rather than on dates or events.

From Alpha Lodge to Gamma Mountain, this route is the one you chose — your own path, in your own order. That's 8 stops in all.
